scripts.build: npm run validate && astro check && astro build --mode production && node scripts/postbuild.ts production && node scripts/check-dist.ts production
scripts.build:demo: npm run validate && astro check && astro build --mode demo && node scripts/postbuild.ts demo && node scripts/check-dist.ts demo
scripts.build:staging: npm run validate && astro check && astro build --mode staging && node scripts/postbuild.ts staging && node scripts/check-dist.ts staging
scripts.db:reset:local: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run check:wrangler -- staging && npm run build:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:staging: npm run check:wrangler -- staging && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.db:seed:staging: npm run check:wrangler -- staging && wrangler d1 execute DB --env staging --remote --file=seeds/staging.sql
scripts.db:migrate:production: npm run check:wrangler -- production && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.db:seed:production: npm run check:wrangler -- production && wrangler d1 execute DB --env production --remote --file=seeds/production.sql
scripts.deploy:production: npm run check:wrangler -- production && npm run build && wrangler deploy --env production
